title: The Debt Collector
text: A grey man with a ledger arrives to collect the kingdom's old debt from its richest House. He sits in the hall with his hat on his knees and does not eat or drink or sleep. He will not leave until he is paid or refused. The dogs will not go near him.

options.label: Pay the kingdom's old debt, and be rid of him (50 Gold).

outcomes.text: He tips his hat, closes the ledger, and leaves. The dogs come back into the hall.

options.label: Refuse the grey man. The kingdom's debts are not yours.

outcomes.text: He writes something in the ledger and leaves. Trade turns cold for every House, and every House knows why.

options.label: Set the Vagabonds on him, and let the ledger go missing.

outcomes.text: The ledger burns. No one asks where he went.
He was expecting that. The ledger's debt doubles.
